snippet.title: God Save Birmingham - Pre-Alpha Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
A new gameplay trailer for God Save Birmingham, an apocalyptic survival game set in 14th century Birmingham, England. The new trailer announces sign-up for the upcoming Pre-Alpha test of the game on Steam. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #godsavebirmingham

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
